moments.title: Premier League Returns!
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off on Friday, August 21st, promising a fresh round of top-flight English football action.

angles.name: Kick-off excitement
angles.copy: The wait is over! Premier League football returns this Friday. Who are you backing to start strong?

angles.name: New season hopes
angles.copy: New season, new hopes. The Premier League is back on Friday – let the drama commence!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival This Week
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival takes over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park from Thursday, August 27th to Sunday, August 30th, with a huge lineup including Chase & Status Live, Florence + The Machine, and Blossoms.

angles.name: Festival countdown
angles.copy: It's almost time! Reading & Leeds Festival kicks off this week. Who's got their wellies packed and ready?

angles.name: Lineup hype
angles.copy: Chase & Status, Florence + The Machine, Blossoms and more! Reading & Leeds is bringing the biggest acts this Bank Holiday weekend.

moments.title: Robert Plant's 78th Birthday
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant celebrates his 78th birthday this Friday, August 20th.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: The Golden God turns 78 this Friday! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Robert Plant.

angles.name: Led Zeppelin vibes
angles.copy: From Stairway to Heaven to solo success, Robert Plant's voice defined an era. Celebrating his 78th this week!

moments.title: Kelis Turns 47
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and chef Kelis, known for hits like 'Milkshake', celebrates her 47th birthday on Saturday, August 21st.

angles.name: Milkshake memories
angles.copy: Her milkshake brings all the beats to the yard! Happy 47th birthday to the incredible Kelis this Saturday.

angles.name: Celebrating Kelis
angles.copy: From R&B queen to culinary star, Kelis has done it all. Sending birthday wishes for her 47th on August 21st!

moments.title: Kacey Musgraves' 38th Birthday
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning country and pop artist Kacey Musgraves celebrates her 38th birthday this Saturday, August 21st.

angles.name: Country star birthday
angles.copy: Happy 38th birthday to the brilliant Kacey Musgraves this Saturday! What's your favourite Kacey track?

angles.name: Golden Hour vibes
angles.copy: Celebrating the artist behind 'Golden Hour'! Kacey Musgraves turns 38 on August 21st.

moments.title: Dua Lipa Turns 31
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa, known for chart-toppers like 'New Rules' and 'Levitating', celebrates her 31st birthday on Sunday, August 22nd.

angles.name: Pop queen birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to dance the night away! Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday this Sunday. What's your top track from her?

angles.name: Celebrating Dua
angles.copy: From London to global sensation, Dua Lipa turns 31 this weekend! Here's to more Future Nostalgia.

moments.title: Back to School Season
moments.blurb: As August draws to a close, the conversation around 'back to school' and the end of summer holidays is ramping up across the UK.

angles.name: End of summer blues
angles.copy: The summer holidays are winding down, and the 'back to school' buzz is starting! Are you ready for September?

angles.name: School prep
angles.copy: Uniforms, stationery, new routines... the great back-to-school prep is underway for many families!

moments.title: Community Shield Post-Match Buzz
moments.blurb: Yesterday's Community Shield saw Manchester City take on Arsenal at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff, sparking debate and discussion amongst football fans.

angles.name: Post-match analysis
angles.copy: Still talking about yesterday's Community Shield? Man City vs Arsenal in Cardiff certainly set the tone for the season!

angles.name: Cardiff host
angles.copy: Cardiff hosted the Community Shield yesterday! Big game, big atmosphere in the Welsh capital.
